## Review checklist

- [ ] The PR has one linked Issue and satisfies its Acceptance Criteria.
- [ ] The change is scoped and contains no unrelated cleanup.
- [ ] Synthetic data only; no secrets, credentials, or private banking/customer data.
- [ ] Failure, false-positive, emergency, replay/duplicate, and accessibility paths were considered where relevant.
- [ ] No unsupported AI, production integration, accuracy, fraud reduction, adoption, revenue, or cost-saving claim was introduced.
- [ ] Follow-up work and known limitations are recorded.
- [ ] The author will not approve their own PR.
